title: MES penalty: friction is ~15% of 1R
detail: Every agent scores PF 0.17-0.34 higher on MNQ than MES. Round-trip friction per contract: MES $2 fees + 2 ticks ($2.50) = $4.50 against 1R of about 1 ATR (~6 pts x $5 = $30), so ~15% of R. MNQ: $3 against ~$60, so ~5% of R. Alpha MES in-sample paid $7,028 in commission alone.
